campus: Catania — Department of Agriculture, Food and Environment (Di3A), Via Santa Sofia 98-100
admission_type: Open access with verification of curricular requirements and personal preparation by oral interview. Non-EU applicants residing abroad follow a separate qualification-based public selection call with a possible online interview or test.
admission_route: Non-EU citizens residing abroad: non_eu_public_selection_call through the UNICT Student Portal. Italian, EU/equated applicants and non-EU citizens legally resident in Italy: open-access master's admission procedure through Smart_Edu; holders of foreign qualifications must first use the EU/equated pre-evaluation webform.
citizenship_track: non_eu_resident_abroad / eu_and_equated / non_eu_resident_in_italy. The EU/equated procedure includes Italian and EU citizens, citizens of Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Switzerland and San Marino, and qualifying non-EU residents in Italy.
academic_requirements: A bachelor's degree, three-year university diploma, or suitable foreign qualification is required. The 2026/27 open-access annex directly identifies Italian classes L-25 (or former class 20), L-2, L-13, L-21, L-26, L-27, L-29, L-32 and L-38. Graduates from another Italian or foreign degree may also qualify if the Degree Course Council recognizes the degree as suitable, verifies adequate personal preparation, and the applicant has at least 60 ECTS in the specified AGRI, BIOS, CHEM, PHYS, CEAR, INFO, IINF, MATH, ECON and MVET sectors. Foreign curricula not expressed in SSD/CFU are assessed for equivalent credits and educational content by the committee.
eligible_bachelor_backgrounds: Agricultural and Forestry Sciences and Technologies; Biotechnology; Biological Sciences; Territorial, Urban, Landscape and Environmental Planning Sciences; Food Science and Technology; Chemical Sciences and Technologies; Pharmaceutical Sciences and Technologies; Environmental and Nature Sciences and Technologies; Zootechnical Sciences and Animal Production Technologies. Other suitable degrees may be accepted after curriculum and preparation assessment.
curricular_subject_prerequisites: For degrees outside the directly listed classes, at least 60 ECTS in one or more of these disciplinary groups: AGRI (Agriculture), BIOS (Biology), CHEM (Chemistry), PHYS (Physics), CEAR (Architecture), INFO (Informatics), IINF (Electronics), MATH (Mathematics), ECON (Economics), and MVET (Veterinary). Applicants must state their CFU and SSD in the application; equivalence is determined by the committee for foreign qualifications without Italian SSD/CFU classifications.
degree_recency_limit: No degree-recency limit is stated in the 2026/27 call, open-access annex, or programme regulation reviewed.
undergraduate_in_progress_allowed: Yes. Non-EU applicants residing abroad may apply before graduation if they obtain the bachelor's degree by 31 July 2026. Under the Italian/EU/equated open-access route, final-year students may apply conditionally if missing requirements are included in their study plan; after passing the interview, by 1 October 2026 they must lack no more than 30 CFU for the degree and/or have earned at least 150 CFU, including the final-exam credits. Conditional enrolment must be regularized by earning the degree by 28 February 2027.
professional_experience_alternative: For the non-EU-abroad selection, candidates seconded from international organisations or foreign national services may also be considered if they hold a university degree and have relevant professional experience. Professional experience does not replace the requirement to hold a university degree.
language_requirements: Good knowledge of English at CEFR B2 or higher is required. In the 2026/27 non-EU-abroad selection, this is attested through the listed certificate thresholds or an accepted exemption.

english_certificate_thresholds.cambridge_min: Cambridge ESOL Preliminary (PET) or Business Preliminary (BEC), or higher

english_certificate_exemptions: A declaration from the university that awarded the bachelor's or master's degree confirming that English was the official language of the programme, or a declaration of citizenship of an English-speaking country.
italian_language_requirement: The 2026/27 non-EU-abroad call states that no Italian-language test is required. The Di3A programme regulation additionally says access requires Italian equivalent to CEFR B2, but foreign students who do not possess it must add educational activities to their study plan to reach the required level; this is therefore recorded as a post-admission study-plan obligation rather than a certificate threshold in the international call.
application_deadline_eu: For EU/equated applicants holding a foreign qualification, pre-evaluation was required by 30 June 2026. The subsequent 2026/27 open-access master's application through Smart_Edu ran from 6 July to 2 September 2026.
application_deadline_non_eu: 17 March 2026 at 23:59 GMT+1 for non-EU applicants residing abroad (applications opened 10 February 2026 at 12:00 GMT+1). Admitted visa applicants also had to submit Universitaly pre-enrolment by 31 July 2026.
results_publication_date: By 6 May 2026 for the non-EU-abroad public selection. For the Italian/EU/equated open-access route, the initial admitted/not-admitted/additional-test lists were due by 9 September 2026; results after the oral interview were due by 24 September 2026.
required_documents: Non-EU-abroad selection: passport personal-data pages; bachelor's certificate or enrolment certificate stating the expected graduation date; official Italian or English translation where needed; transcript listing courses, examinations, grades, grading range and preferably GPA; official course syllabi on university letterhead or bearing the university stamp; reference letter, preferably from a university lecturer; Europass-format CV in English; English-language certificate or exemption evidence; statement of purpose in English (maximum 4,000 characters); summary sheet; and any optional supporting documents. EU/equated applicants with a foreign title must provide the foreign bachelor's qualification, academic record/transcript or self-certification, identity document, and recognition documentation required by the pre-evaluation/enrolment route.
entry_exam_or_test: The open-access route verifies personal preparation through an oral interview on 22 September 2026 at 09:30, either in person at Di3A, Via Santa Sofia 98-100, Catania, or online. It covers the published admission syllabus, motivation, synthesis, subject mastery and communication skills. For the non-EU-abroad selection, qualifications are scored out of 100: academic record up to 50 points, relevance of previous studies and experience up to 40, reference letter up to 5, and statement of purpose/motivation up to 5. The board may request an online interview/test; 50/100 is the suitability threshold.
credential_recognition_documents: For the non-EU-abroad application, foreign degree and transcript documents not in Italian or English require official translations, and official syllabi must be on university letterhead or validated with the university stamp. A Declaration of Value or Statement of Comparability is optional at application but, at enrolment, the applicant must deliver an ENIC/NARIC/CIMEA Statement of Comparability and qualification verification or a Declaration of Value, along with passport and study visa, Italian tax code and residence-permit request. EU/equated holders of foreign qualifications must present a Declaration of Value or CIMEA verification/comparability documentation under the open-access procedure.
tuition_or_fees_link: https://www.unict.it/it/corsi-numero-programmato/2026-2027/public-selection-admission-non-eu-students-living-abroad-english (the official call linked here states total 2026/27 tuition of EUR 306 for non-EU students residing abroad). Italian/EU/equated applicants are directed to the 2026/27 Manifesto degli Studi via https://www.unict.it/it/corsi-numero-non-programmato/2026-2027/procedura-di-ammissione-al-1%C2%B0-anno-corsi-di-laurea-magistrale
application_fee: EUR 10 per programme application for the 2026/27 non-EU-abroad selection. The open-access procedure states no application fee, but a EUR 35 charge is added to the second tuition instalment when an additional test or interview is required.
enrolment_confirmation_fee: EUR 75, non-refundable, due within 15 days of admission notification for admitted non-EU-abroad applicants; it is deducted from the EUR 150 annual comprehensive contribution. The Italian/EU/equated route requires a fixed EUR 156 enrolment payment (EUR 140 regional tax plus EUR 16 stamp duty).
places_quota_non_eu: [uncertain] The 2026/27 public-facing call table does not state a programme-specific number; the places cell for LM-69 R is blank.
places_quota_total: [uncertain] No total capacity is published; the programme is officially classified as open access/non-programmed.
application_portal_url: Non-EU abroad and open-access admission: https://studenti.smartedu.unict.it/ ; EU/equated foreign-qualification pre-evaluation: https://webform.unict.it/en/pre-evaluation-form-english-taught-master-degree-courses-eu-and-equated-citizens-only ; visa pre-enrolment: https://www.universitaly.it/
governing_decree_reference: D.R. 392 of 4 February 2026 (non-EU students residing abroad); D.R. 2233 of 23 June 2026 (open-access two-year master's admission procedure).

uncertainty_notes: The official programme title is inconsistent across the source set: the programme page and central 2026/27 lists use 'Agricultural Science and Technology' (singular), while some annex text uses 'Agricultural Sciences and Technologies'; this record uses the programme-page title. The current 2026/27 annex requires 60 ECTS for applicants from other degree classes, whereas the live programme overview still says 50 CFU; the newer cycle-specific annex was treated as controlling. The programme regulation says Italian B2 is required but allows foreign students lacking it to add learning activities, while the international call explicitly says no Italian test is required. No 2026/27 seat quota is visible in the public call table.
